cards.card_text: Now God gives Ezekiel the menu for his 390 days on his side: wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet and spelt, all made into bread for himself.
cards.verse_text: But take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt; put them in a single container and make them into bread for yourself.
